paragraphs.source_en: The confusion in Ōtani’s army, suddenly attacked, can well be imagined—their own allies had turned against them on the battlefield, leveling their finest arquebuses at them in unison...

paragraphs.source_en: When the wretched Hideaki brazenly launched his attack on the Ōtani camp, Ōtani was first stunned, then flew into a rage. In this decisive battle, Kobayakawa Hideaki had utterly crippled him: Kobayakawa’s vacillation had left him unable either to advance or retreat, immobilized. Unable to decide whether to trust Hideaki, he had hesitated to the last—only to be struck from behind after all.

units.source_en: He understood now that everything ended here—that his life ended here.
units.source_zh: 他已然明白，一切到此为止，他的一生到此为止。

units.source_en: All around him had suddenly fallen silent. Either every one of his men had been annihilated and the enemy had turned its spearhead toward Ukita’s force, or he himself had lost his hearing.
units.source_zh: 周围突然静了下来，要么是自己的人马已全部被歼，敌人又把矛头转向宇喜多部，要么就是自己已失去了听觉。

paragraphs.source_zh: 吉继小声道：“把轿子停下。”他已然明白，一切到此为止，他的一生到此为止。周围突然静了下来，要么是自己的人马已全部被歼，敌人又把矛头转向宇喜多部，要么就是自己已失去了听觉。

paragraphs.source_en: To discover what had happened, Yoshitsugu held his breath and listened intently to the sounds around him. Then he relaxed again, feeling as though he were bathed in gentle sunlight.

units.source_en: To discover what had happened, Yoshitsugu held his breath and listened intently to the sounds around him. Then he relaxed again, feeling as though he were bathed in gentle sunlight.

paragraphs.source_zh: 为了弄清楚究竟是怎么回事，吉继屏息凝神，静听周围的动静，旋又松弛下来，他只觉得仿佛置身于淡淡的阳光之中。

paragraphs.source_en: Who had driven him into this abyss of misery? Had he sinned in a former life and been fated to receive his punishment here?

units.source_en: Who had driven him into this abyss of misery?

paragraphs.source_en: Mitsunari had once sat beside him and, without the slightest concern, drunk thick tea from a bowl that he, a leper, had used. At that time, no one else had wished even to share a place with him. Perhaps it was the emotion he had felt then that had drawn him onto today’s battlefield.

paragraphs.source_en: Yet today, as Yoshitsugu reflected that all was about to end, life seemed mysteriously to transcend everything—even to his own disbelief—and at last he felt a faint ray of sunlight fall upon him. “Gosuke, has the sun come out?”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes... yes. But a light rain has begun again.”
